description: This file implements an AI gatekeeper module that evaluates whether certain actions should be approved or denied based on safety principles. It includes functions for assessing tool usage, checking git repository status, and constructing prompts for safety evaluation.

methods.name: evaluateGatekeeperApproval
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a tool usage should be approved based on AI safety principles, considering configuration, cost, and context.

methods.name: getGitRepository
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the git repository for a given workspace directory.

methods.name: isFileTrackedByGit
methods.description: Checks if a specific file is tracked by git within the workspace.

methods.name: extractFilePathsFromCommand
methods.description: Parses a command string to extract file paths, considering heuristics to distinguish commands from file paths.

methods.name: buildGatekeeperPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a safety prompt describing the intended action, including context about git repository status and file operations.
